## indv-disclaimer-trust

Massachusetts individual disclaimer trust for married clients. The trust distributes outright to the surviving spouse, with disclaimer provisions creating a Marital Trust (QTIP) and Family Trust (bypass/credit shelter) when the spouse disclaims. Includes descendants' trusts with staged withdrawal rights.

| Document | Template | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Individual Disclaimer Trust | `templates/indv-disclaimer-trust.docx` | `02-indv-disclaimer-trust.docx` |

# Design-sheet selection rules

How `deriveEstateGeneratorPackages()` (lib/estateGenerator/toGeneratorData.ts) turns `payload.documents.include_*` inclusions into packages. Inclusions come from the design sheet's `decisions.document_inclusions` (lib/designSheetDocumentInclusions.ts).

| Inclusion key | Package(s) | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| `include_trust` | `joint-trust` | `matter.type === "married_joint"` and not `trust.separate_trusts` |
| `include_trust` | `joint-trust-simplified` | `matter.type === "married_joint"` with `trust.separate_trusts` |
| `include_trust` | `indv-disclaimer-trust` | `trust_planning_type === "disclaimer"` and `matter.type === "married_individual"` |
| `include_trust` | `trust-individual-single` | any other non-joint matter |
| `include_simple_will` | `simple-will` | always when included |
| `include_testamentary_trust_will` | `testamentary-trust-will` | always when included |
| `include_testamentary_trust_will` | `spouse-testamentary-trust-will` | also requires `spouse_docs` |
| `include_pour_over_will` | `pourover-will` | always when included |
| `include_pour_over_will` | `spouse-pourover-will` | also requires `spouse_docs` |
| `include_dpoa` | `incapacity-documents` | any of `include_dpoa` / `include_hcp` / `include_hipaa` / `include_ahd` |
| `include_hcp` | `incapacity-documents` | any of the four incapacity inclusions (single package) |
| `include_hipaa` | `incapacity-documents` | any of the four incapacity inclusions (single package) |
| `include_ahd` | `incapacity-documents` | any of the four incapacity inclusions (single package) |
| `include_dpoa` | `spouse-incapacity-documents` | any incapacity inclusion plus `spouse_docs` |
| `include_ppm` | `personal-property-memorandum` | always when included |
| `include_parental_appointment` | `parental-guardian-appointment` | always when included |
| `include_temp_delegation` | `temporary-delegation-parental-powers` | always when included |
| `include_certificate_of_trust` | `certificate-of-trust` | always when included |
| `include_assignment_of_personal_property` | `assignment-of-personal-property` | always when included |
| `include_funding_instructions` | `funding-instructions` | always when included |
| `include_funding_recommendation` | `trust-funding-plan` | always when included |
| `include_homestead_trustee` | `homestead-trustee` | always when included |
| `include_young_adult_estate_plan` | `young-adult-estate-plan` | one package per qualifying child (DOB age 17.5–25) |
| `include_estate_plan_summary` | `estate-plan-summary` | appended whenever any other package generates, unless explicitly `false` |

Manifests never selected by `deriveEstateGeneratorPackages()`: `core-estate`, `design-summary` (`design-summary` is generated from its own design-sheet action; `core-estate` is legacy and not in `NODE_SUPPORTED_PACKAGES`).
